steps.content: The situation is swiftly brought under control. The assassins are confirmed to be not Sinner, devoid of potent weaponry. With the Fraser delegation's aid in freeing several hostages, the attackers are now cornered, their escape routes cut off.

But a creeping unease settles in your chest, the familiar kind that whispers of danger before it arrives. Instinctively, you rush to Jasmine. She's still in the car, obediently waiting, waving and smiling at you. You sigh in relief, but just as you step closer to remind her—

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Chief, behind you!
A fresh wave of chaos erupts as something rapidly approaches you, carving a brutal path through the crowd. The air shrieks with agony, the sound of rending flesh and terror closing in.
As the victims fall one after another, you finally get a clear view of the perpetrator's frenzied face—
[Transition] Corrupted Soldier Portrait

steps.speaker: FAC Captain
steps.content: That's not an Outlander assassin—it's someone from the Ring Institute! But... something's off about him!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What's the deal with those blades...

steps.speaker: Security
steps.content: Eeehahahaha!!!

steps.speaker: FAC Captain
steps.content: Damn it, he's completely lost it... Stop him!

The man, possessed by the deadly blades, stands with eyes wide open, pupils swallowed. His body jerks unnaturally, as if the weapon in his hands is the one controlling him, cutting down every living soul in sight. Seeing the enemy charge at you, a swarm of FAC guards rush over.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Wait! Stay back!

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: A correct decision. I can only protect you, Chief.

As it speaks, Schorl rushes forward, intercepting the first strike of the dual blades meant for you. But just as Schorl prepares to counter, the "man" pivots past him, surging onward as if you were never his true target at all.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Jasmine!

He slashes open the vehicle holding Jasmine with a single strike. A hand extends from within. The dancer braces against his shoulder, then in one fluid motion, flips over him gracefully. Finally free, she escapes the cage that has served as both her prison and her sanctuary.
Jasmine takes in the scene, her delight unmistakable.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: I warned you not to touch those blades... They're dangerous, cruel, thirsty for blood... They are DisCity's weapon, your weapon...

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: You look so troubled, Chief. Won't you let me help you? I'm the only one who can, after all.
[Action sequence: Jasmine subdues the guard controlled by the blades.]

You hesitate to use your shackles while the two are locked in close combat, fearing even a split second of interference might cost Jasmine her life. Sensing your hesitation, her smile brightens. Her movements are fluid, dodging his savage strikes with feline grace, weaving around him like a serpent circling an enraged bear.

In just a few swift moves, she leaps onto the monster's shoulders, locking her legs around his throat from behind. With a sharp twist, she wrenches his arms in the opposite direction, effortlessly pinning her bear-like opponent in an unbreakable hold.
The blades lose their hold on their puppet, shuddering violently as they unleash a terrifying wave of contamination.

steps.speaker: Security
steps.content: You... It's you...

steps.speaker: Security
steps.content: I'll kill you!!

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Shut up! Do as I say!

With brutal efficiency, she wrenches the poor researcher's arms from his body, cutting short his agonized scream. Jasmine lets out a laugh as she pries the blades from the severed hands—their stiff fingers still clinging desperately to the hilts. Tossing the lifeless limbs aside, she now reclaims her "weapon."
The frenzied twin blades roar, then howl—struggling, trembling—until at last, like a guttering flame, they fall silent in her hands.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Haha... That's better... You're nothing but a pair of blades. Who you kill and where you strike—it all happens on my command.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Now...
She takes a deep breath, as if savoring freedom, and opens her eyes to watch artillery fire bursting in the sky, her face alight with childlike wonder.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: The fireworks... so pretty...

Yet the blades in her hands thrum with a savage, murderous energy. Now that the weapon is back in her grasp, you feel for the first time the maniacal power emanating from this seemingly fragile dancer.
She hears your call and turns her head, her smile bright against the smoky veil of gunpowder, lit by fractured rays of sun.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Thank you for bringing me to the closing ceremony. Finally, my wish will come true. The celebration I've waited for all these years... it's finally starting. Wait for me, Chief.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Once this is over, I'll come straight back to you. Just like we promised.
Her smile carries a barely perceptible hint of apology.
